description: A Compare frame encoded by Python's struct module, independently of both implementations. Mode 1 is raw; flags 104 is synced (8), compared (32) and inverted (64); views 0 and laneCount 3: this track, the partner and their sum follow the 80-byte header, in the order of the lanes message with laneSet 42. The partner lags by 62.5 samples with opposite polarity; the sum is 6.5 dB below unrelated, 2.75 dB above with the fix.
